verses.en: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.pt: Estes, pois, são os chefes de suas casas paternas, e esta é a genealogia dos que subiram comigo de Babilônia no reinado do rei Artaxerxes:
verses.en_web: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the heads of families who were listed of those who went up with me from Babylon, when Artaxerxes was king.

verses.en: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Finéias, Gérson; dos filhos de Itamar, Daniel; dos filhos de Davi, Hatus;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom; of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; of the sons of David, Hattush;

verses.en: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Secanias, dos filhos de Parós, Zacarias; e com ele, segundo as genealogias dos varões, se contaram cento e cinqüenta;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Shecaniah; of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed a hundred and fifty males.

verses.en: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Paate-Moabe, Elioenai, filho de Zeraías, e com ele duzentos homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai, the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

verses.en: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Zatu, Secanias, o filho de Jaaziel, e com ele trezentos homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

verses.en: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Adim, Ebede, filho de Jônatas, e com ele cinqüenta homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Adin, Ebed, the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

verses.en: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Elão, Jesaías, filho de Atalias, e com ele setenta homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah; the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

verses.en: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Sefatias, Zebadias, filho de Micael, e com ele oitenta homens; e
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah, the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

verses.en: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Joabe, Obadias, filho de Jeiel, e com ele duzentos e dezoito homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah, the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

verses.en: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Bani, Selomite, o filho de Josifias, e com ele cento e sessenta homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him a hundred and sixty males.

verses.en: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Bebai, Zacarias, o filho de Bebai, e com ele vinte e oito homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah, the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

verses.en: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Azgade, Joanã, o filho de Hacatã, e com ele cento e dez homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Azgad, Johanan, the son of Hakkatan; and with him a hundred and ten males.

verses.en: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Adonicão, que eram os últimos, eis os seus nomes: Elifelete, Jeuel e Semaías, e com eles sessenta homens;
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last; and these are their names: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Adonikam, the last, whose names were Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

verses.en: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
verses.pt: e dos filhos de Bigvai, Utai e Zabude, e com eles setenta homens.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

verses.en: And I gathered them together to the river than runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.pt: Ajuntei-os à margem do rio que corre para Ava; e ficamos ali acampados três dias. Então passei em revista o povo e os sacerdotes, e não achei ali nenhum dos filhos de Levi.
verses.en_web: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days: and I looked around at the people the priests, and found there were none of the sons of Levi.
verses.en_bbe: And I made them come together by the river flowing to Ahava; and we were there in tents for three days: and after viewing the people and the priests I saw that no sons of Levi were there.

verses.en: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.pt: Mandei, pois, chamar Eliézer, Ariel, Semaías, Elnatã, Jaribe, Elnatã, Natã, Zacarias e Mesulão, os chefes, como também, Joiaribe e Elnatã, que eram mestres.
verses.en_web: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.
verses.en_bbe: Then I sent for Eliezer and Ariel and Shemaiah and Elnathan Jarib and Elnathan and Nathan and Zechariah and Meshullam, all responsible men; and for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were wise men.

verses.en: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
verses.pt: E os enviei a Ido, chefe em Casífia, e lhes pus na boca palavras para dizerem a Ido e aos seus irmãos, os netinins, em Casífia, que nos trouxessem ministros para a casa do nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo, and his brothers the temple servants, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.
verses.en_bbe: And I sent them to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and gave them orders what to say to Iddo and his brothers the Nethinim at the place Casiphia, so that they might come back to us with men to do the work of the house of our God.

verses.en: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
verses.pt: E, pela boa mão de nosso Deus sobre nós, trouxeram-nos um homem entendido, dos filhos de Mali, filho de Levi, filho de Israel; e Serebias, com os seus filhos e irmãos, dezoito;
verses.en_web: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;
verses.en_bbe: And by the help of our God they got for us Ish-sechel, one of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah with his sons and brothers, eighteen;

verses.en: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
verses.pt: e Hasabias, e com ele Jesaías, dos filhos de Merári, com seus irmãos e os filhos deles, vinte;
verses.en_web: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;
verses.en_bbe: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

verses.en: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
verses.pt: e dos netinins, que Davi e os príncipes tinham dado para o serviço dos levitas, duzentos e vinte, todos eles mencionados por nome.
verses.en_web: and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants. All of them were mentioned by name.
verses.en_bbe: And of the Nethinim, to whom David and the captains had given the work of helping the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim, all of them specially named.

verses.en: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
verses.pt: Então proclamei um jejum ali junto ao rio Ava, para nos humilharmos diante do nosso Deus, a fim de lhe pedirmos caminho seguro para nós, para nossos pequeninos, e para toda a nossa fazenda.
verses.en_web: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our possessions.
verses.en_bbe: Then I gave orders for a time of going without food, there by the river Ahava, so that we might make ourselves low before our God in prayer, requesting from him a straight way for us and for our little ones and for all our substance.

verses.en: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
verses.pt: Pois tive vergonha de pedir ao rei uma escolta de soldados, e cavaleiros para nos defenderem do inimigo pelo caminho, porquanto havíamos dito ao rei: A mão do nosso Deus é sobre todos os que o buscam, para o bem deles; mas o seu poder e a sua ira estão contra todos os que o deixam.
verses.en_web: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”
verses.en_bbe: For I would not, for shame, make request to the king for a band of armed men and horsemen to give us help against those who might make attacks on us on the way: for we had said to the king, The hand of our God is on his servants for good, but his power and his wrath are against all those who are turned away from him.

verses.en: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
verses.pt: Nós, pois, jejuamos, e pedimos isto ao nosso Deus; e ele atendeu às nossas orações.
verses.en_web: So we fasted and begged our God for this: and he granted our request.
verses.en_bbe: So we went without food, requesting our God for this: and his ear was open to our prayer.

verses.en: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
verses.pt: Então separei doze dos principais dentre os sacerdotes: Serebias e Hasabias, e com eles dez dos seus irmãos;
verses.en_web: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,
verses.en_bbe: So I put on one side twelve of the chiefs of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

verses.en: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
verses.pt: e pesei-lhes a prata, o ouro e os vasos, a oferta para a casa do nosso Deus, que o rei, os seus conselheiros, os seus príncipes e todo o Israel que estava ali haviam oferecido;
verses.en_web: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.
verses.en_bbe: And gave to them by weight the silver and the gold and the vessels, all the offering for the house of our God which the king and his wise men and his captains and all Israel there present had given:

verses.en: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
verses.pt: entreguei-lhes nas mãos seiscentos e cinqüenta talentos de prata, e em vasos de prata cem talentos; e cem talentos de ouro;
verses.en_web: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels; one hundred talents of gold,
verses.en_bbe: Measuring into their hands six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels, a hundred talents' weight, and a hundred talents of gold,

verses.en: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
verses.pt: e vinte taças de ouro no valor de mil dáricos, e dois vasos de bronze claro e brilhante, tão precioso como o ouro.
verses.en_web: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics; and two vessels of fine bright brass, precious as gold.
verses.en_bbe: And twenty gold basins, of a thousand darics, and two vessels of the best bright brass, equal in value to gold.

verses.en: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.
verses.pt: E disse-lhes: Vós sois santos ao Senhor, e santos são estes vasos; como também esta prata e este ouro são ofertas voluntárias, oferecidas ao Senhor, Deus de vossos pais.
verses.en_web: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a freewill offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.
verses.en_bbe: And I said to them, You are holy to the Lord and the vessels are holy: and the silver and the gold are an offering freely given to the Lord, the God of your fathers.

verses.en: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: Vigiai, pois, e guardai-os até que os peseis na presença dos principais dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, e dos príncipes das casas paternas de Israel, em Jerusalém, nas câmaras da casa do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Watch and keep them, until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”
verses.en_bbe: Take care of them and keep them, till you put them on the scales before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and the chiefs of the families of Israel, in Jerusalem, in the rooms of the house of the Lord.

verses.en: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
verses.pt: Então os sacerdotes e os levitas receberam o peso da prata, e do ouro, e dos vasos, a fim de os trazerem para Jerusalém, para a casa do nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.
verses.en_bbe: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of silver and gold and the vessels, to take them to Jerusalem into the house of our God.

verses.en: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
verses.pt: Então partimos do rio Ava, no dia doze do primeiro mês, a fim de irmos para Jerusalém; e a mão do nosso Deus estava sobre nós, e ele nos livrou da mão dos inimigos, e dos que nos armavam ciladas pelo caminho.
verses.en_web: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandit by the way.
verses.en_bbe: Then we went away from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was on us, and he gave us salvation from our haters and those who were waiting to make an attack on us by the way.

verses.en: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
verses.pt: Chegamos, pois, a Jerusalém, e repousamos ali três dias.
verses.en_web: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.
verses.en_bbe: And we came to Jerusalem and were there for three days.

verses.en: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
verses.pt: No quarto dia se pesou a prata, e o ouro, e os vasos, na casa do nosso Deus, para as mãos de Meremote filho do sacerdote Urias; e com ele estava Eleazar, filho de Finéias, e com eles os levitas Jozabade, filho de Jesuá, e Noadias, filho de Binuí.
verses.en_web: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levite;
verses.en_bbe: And on the fourth day, the silver and the gold and the vessels were measured out by weight in the house of our God into the hands of Meremoth, the son of Uriah, the priest; and with him was Eleazar, the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad, the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah, the son of Binnui, the Levites;

verses.en: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
verses.pt: Tudo foi entregue por número e peso; e o peso de tudo foi registrado na ocasião.
verses.en_web: everything by number and by weight; and all the weight was written at that time.
verses.en_bbe: All was handed over by number and by weight: and the weight was put on record at that time.

verses.en: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.pt: Os exilados que tinham voltado do cativeiro ofereceram holocaustos ao Deus de Israel: doze novilhos por todo o Israel, noventa e seis carneiros, setenta e sete cordeiros, e doze bodes em oferta pelo pecado; tudo em holocausto ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And those who had been prisoners, who had come back from a strange land, made burned offerings to the God of Israel, twelve oxen for all Israel, ninety-six male sheep, seventy-seven lambs, twelve he-goats for a sin-offering: all this was a burned offering to the Lord.

verses.en: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
verses.pt: Então entregaram os editos do rei aos sátrapas do rei, e aos governadores a oeste do Rio; e estes ajudaram o povo e a casa de Deus.
verses.en_web: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s satraps, and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave the king's orders to the king's captains and the rulers across the river, and they gave the people and the house of God the help which was needed.
